title: ComputeInfo
description: GET /v1/info (authenticated): /health's fields plus operational details. 'limits' and 'tools' differ per worker.

status.description: degraded: up, but cannot run jobs (e.g. splat tools missing).

kinds.description: The kinds this worker serves. The app uses splat-prepare/splat-finish only when both are listed.

maxQuality.description: splat-worker: the highest quality it trains itself (only when its tools are ok).

prepareOutputs.description: splat-worker: what splat-prepare returns and accepts beyond the bundle ('sparse.zip', 'anchors'); markerless captures need both.

auth.description: Whether the worker requires a key.

maxPhotos.description: The app reads this before it starts or redoes a capture.

tools.description: splat-worker: tool paths, versions, trainer and GPU backend.
